text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Top Road, happy birthday! Tocelebrate, I've prepared an abridgedperformance of my encounter withyou from the opera Legend of theCenturial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto and I also have a celebratory<n>song to sing!
The performance will be<n>later today at the outdoor
stage!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Umm... So sorry! My friends are<n>actually throwing
me a birthday party<n>today...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! Of c-c-course! Why wouldn't<n>you be busy on
your birthday?<n>S-s-s-sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If you'd like, why don't you come<n>to my
birthday party?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then you could sing your celebration<n>song there.
I'd really appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Excellent idea! My mellifluous<n>voice shall
reach that many more<n>pairs of ears!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-are you sure we wouldn't be<n>imposing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to have you there! The<n>party's sure to be a
good time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And as for your opera, would you be<n>open to doing
it another day?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll go ahead and book the<n>stage then!
